title: USER II Treatment of Ancient DNA Extracts
author: Alba Rey-Iglesia
materials: In a PCR tube, add 4.8 µL Thermolabile USER II Enzyme - 250 units New England Biolabs Catalog #M5508L to 27.2 µL DNA extract, for a final reaction volume of 32 µL.
In a thermocycler, incubate the reaction for 3 hours at 37°C then cool down to 10ºC. Can be left overnight at 10ºC.

steps.title: Prepare Spin Column
steps.instruction: Prepare a Monarch DNA Cleanup Column (5ug, NEB #T1034L or replacement #T2037L), ensuring the film is not touched and liquids do not attach to the walls.

steps.title: Equilibrate Column
steps.instruction: Add 450 µl modified Buffer PB to the spin column.

steps.title: Wash Column
steps.instruction: Add 650 µl Buffer PE (Qiagen #19065) to the spin column and centrifuge at max speed for 1 min to dry the column.

steps.title: Prepare Elution Tube
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a fresh 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube. Use LoBind tubes (Eppendorf #022431021) if available; otherwise, use EBT buffer instead of EB buffer for final elution.

steps.title: Initial Elution
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL Buffer EB (Qiagen #19086) to the spin column. If LoBind tubes are not used, add 20 µL EBT buffer instead.

steps.title: Perform USER II Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat the DNA extract with USER II enzyme.

substeps.instruction: Optional: Add 2.4 µL USER II enzyme to 13.6 µL DNA extract (final volume 16 µL) to preserve some untreated extract.

steps.title: Load Treated DNA
steps.instruction: Add the entire USER II-DNA reaction (either 32 µL or 16 µL) to the column and mix by pipetting or inversion.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Discard
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 8,000 RPM in a benchtop centrifuge for 1 min and discard the flow through.

steps.title: Repeat Elution and Wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the steps for adding elution/wash buffer and centrifuging (corresponding to steps 4.8-4.10 in the original source).

steps.title: Incubate and Final Spin
steps.instruction: Incubate for 5 mins at room temperature to allow DNA to elute and dissolve in the buffer, then centrifuge at max speed for 1 min.

steps.title: Store Eluted DNA
steps.instruction: Discard the spin column and store the eluted DNA at -20ºC.
